visualCharacteristics: Two-column featured/case-study row on a white background. Left column is a single 3:2 cover image; right column holds a breadcrumb, an H2 heading, and an author/date/read-time meta line.
contentPattern: Single row, two cells. Cell 1: image. Cell 2: breadcrumb + heading + author meta.
usage: Use to feature a single article or case study with its cover image alongside its title and byline.
